title: Sets
description: A set is which components are installed; a profile (the next tab) is how they are set up. Your own named component sets, like the “Сборки” tab of МОСТ. Applying one opens the install wizard with it. Sets live in %APPDATA%\TriOtmetki and move by code or file; syncing through the site comes later.
emptyHint: Save the components that are on under a name to come back to them in one click.
saveDescription: The components that are on in the selected client.
saveHint: The set gets {count, plural, one {# component} other {# components}}
name: Name
importDescription: A TS1.… code from a friend, a .tmset file or the file of all sets from another computer.
deleteDescription: The installed components do not change.
